title: AWS Cost Management
description: Monitor AWS spending, set budgets, and optimize costs for ASP.NET Core workloads.

data.text: AWS costs can grow quickly without visibility. AWS Cost Management and budgets help you track spending, set alerts, and optimize resources without surprise bills.
Key Cost Drivers for ASP.NET Core Apps

items: **Elastic Beanstalk / ECS** — pay for EC2 and Fargate resources even when idle
**CloudWatch** — logs and metrics ingestion and storage

data.title: Cost alerts
data.text: Create alerts at 50%, 80%, and 100% of budget so you are notified before charges accumulate.

data.title: Create a cost budget and alert
data.description: Protect yourself from unexpected AWS charges during this course.
steps: Open the AWS Billing and Cost Management console
Create a budget of $25 for AWS services used in this course
Review the cost explorer for the current month
data.expectedOutcome: You have an active budget with email alerts and understand which resources cost the most.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: AWS Cost Management provides budgets, alerts, and cost analysis
Set budgets early to avoid surprise charges
Elastic Beanstalk and RDS are usually the largest cost drivers
Use dev/test pricing and stop non-production resources
data.takeaway: Cost management is part of running production apps on AWS. Budgets and alerts keep learning and experimentation affordable.
